title: PARACITY Glass Tea Cups Set of 2, 4.3oz Clear High Borosilicate Glass Teacups with Handle, DIshwasher Safe Tea Cup for Espresso Cappuccino Latte Juice
description:
About this item
COMFORTABLE HANDLE: The glass tea cups features convenient handles, making it easy for hands of all sizes to hold and it will not burn your hands.
HIGH BOROSILICATE GLASS: The teacups is crafted from heat-resistant, lead-free borosilicate glass, making it safe, eco-friendly, and free from harmful substances. Borosilicate glass enables teacup to withstand sudden temperature differences of 20°C-150°C. The teacups are also very easy to clean, requiring only a quick hand wash or being dishwasher safe for convenience.
WIDE VARIETY OF USES: The teacups is highly versatile, suitable for holding tea, coffee, milk, lattes, juice, desserts, smoothies, or any beverage you prefer. Additionally, these teacups are an excellent option to bring along for outdoor activities.
STYLISH DESIGN AND PEACE OF MIND: Our glass tea cups clear appearance, smooth and delicate lines, good hand feeling, 4.3 oz (150ml) clear glass cup for tea, size is just right for tea, espresso, and more.
OUTSTANDING CLARITY AND TRANSPARENCY: These glass coffee mugs boast a distinct visual charm. Their crystal-clear design showcases the rich hues and consistency of your coffee or tea, making them ideal for serving artisanal beverages or elegant presentations.

reviews_5s:
Yes the glass is on the thin side, but they fit under my LaPavoni beautifully.This mugs are so cute and tiny. They are great for my coffee shots.They work well and they look goodThese are teeny tiny. Super cute.These are a great size for a double shot and they’re elegant.I bought this thinking they were regular size cups. Please don't make that mistake. These are espresso shot cups. They hold about 2 shots of espresso. They are super cute, light weight, good quality and fit perfectly in your espresso machine. It's also super easy to clean. If you're looking for a cute espresso cup, this is a good affordable option.We have been using these PARACITY espresso cups (set of 2) with our espresso pod machines and they fit well under all of them, from Nespresso, to Keureg, to Lavazza. The cups are large enough to fit a double shot have room to stir in sugar or cream to your liking without spilling over the edge. They are comfortable to drink from but are a bit difficult to pour from if you are adding to a steamed milk beverage or pouring over ice cream. Overall we are happy with these, especially for the price.I like this “PARACITY Glass Tea Cups Set of 2, 4.3 oz Clear Glass Cup for Tea, 150ml Clear Glass Tea Cup With Handle for Tealover, Small Coffee Mug Sets Perfect for Espresso Shot, Suitable for Milk Juice.” Contrary to the marketing, I don’t see using this as a “Tealover” or for “Milk Juice” LOL. It’s small - see the photo for how my medium-sized hand dwarfs the cup. You could make a case for a very strong tea like what’s served in small Turkish tea cups, but I think most people would use this for an espresso - specifically a double shot. It works great for that, fitting easily under the spout of even small espresso machines. A 4 oz. shot, or smaller if you leave room for a lot of crema or are adding frothed milk, gives you a lot of flavor. So you can also use this for a single shot lungo (long pull), or a cortado/cortadito, or a cafecito.

The handle has a nice width to it. A lot of small, thin-glass cups like these have ridiculously thin handles that make them hard to hold, the weight of the contents becoming unbalanced and feeling heavy in your hand. No issues with this design - comfortable to hold, looks great, and is the perfect size for a variety of small, bold coffee drinks. The pair comes packaged safely in a cardboard box, with each cup in bubble wrap and a section of cardboard in between the two. Solid 5 stars.I kind of like these. They're interesting, the material, which claims to be glass, almost feels like a glass/plastic hybrid. Maybe that's what high borosilicate glass feels like, I don't know I'm not a botanist. But they feel almost a little more durable than glass, like they might survive a drop. I'm certainly not going to test it though. It's a little tiny espresso cup, it can only have so many attributes so its hard to review beyond the vibes I felt when drinking an espresso out of it, and even though I like to think I've got a pretty strong vocabulary, the word that refuses to leave my mind is: good. These are good.My tea snob friend refuses to drink tea from a cup that is not clear and doesn't want to drink tea that is not piping hot. She just dumps it. These are perfect for the tea snob in your life! They are not too small, about 4oz, and are made from high quality glass that keep the drinks hot. I have really enjoyed using them when she is over. There is no more wasted tea.
reviews_1s: These are about as thick as a sheet of paper, they feel like they will shatter if I breath on them wrong. Do not buy.
